title: IMDb Movies by Year (1920-2026)
subtitle: Top 1,000 IMDb films per year with ratings, box office, awards and credits
description:
# IMDb Movies by Year (1920-2026)

**107,000 feature films** from IMDb: the top 1,000 per release year from 1920 to 2026, ranked by US box office. Each film has ratings, money figures, awards, parental-guide severities, full credits with person IDs, release dates and alternative titles. That makes **98 typed columns** per film.

## Files

```text
README.md                     this file
data_dictionary.csv           type and description of every column
merged_movies_data_1920.csv   one file per release year
merged_movies_data_1921.csv
...
merged_movies_data_2026.csv   107 files in all
```

The files sit side by side here. In the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/RaedAddala/Scraping-IMDB) each one is in its year folder (`Data/1920/merged_movies_data_1920.csv`).

- Every CSV has the **same 98 columns in the same order**, so you can concatenate them directly.
- Each file has **1,000 rows**, one per film, keyed by `imdb_id` (`tt0114709`). Files range from about 2 to 10 MB, 642 MB in total.
- Files are UTF-8, with a header row and comma separators. Fields that contain commas or newlines are quoted.
- Rows follow IMDb's search order for that year: US box-office gross, highest first. Films with no recorded gross come after the grossing ones, in no meaningful order.

## Columns

`data_dictionary.csv` gives the type and full description of every column, one row per column, in file order. By group:

| Group | Columns |
| --- | --- |
| **Listing** | `imdb_id`, `search_year`, `listing_rank`, `listing_title` |
| **Title** | `title`, `original_title`, `title_type`, `release_year`, `is_adult`, `production_status`, `plot`, `poster_url`, `certificate`, `runtime_seconds`, `release_date`, `release_date_precision` (`year`/`month`/`day`), `release_date_country` |
| **Ratings & reviews** | `imdb_rating` (1-10), `imdb_votes`, `metascore` (0-100), `top_rated_rank`, `rating_histogram` (votes for 1..10), `user_reviews_count`, `critic_reviews_count` |
| **Money** | Amount/currency pairs for `budget_*`, `gross_us_canada_*`, `gross_worldwide_*` and `opening_weekend_us_canada_*`, plus `opening_weekend_end_date`. Amounts are in their original currency and are not converted. |
| **Awards** | `award_wins`, `award_nominations` (nominations that did not win), `prestigious_award_name` / `_wins` / `_nominations` (for example Oscar) |
| **Tags & places** | `genres`, `interests` (themes, sub-genres, franchises), `keywords` + `keywords_total`, `countries_of_origin`, `languages`, `production_companies`, `filming_locations` + `filming_locations_total` |
| **Similar titles** | `similar_movie_ids`, `similar_movie_titles`, `similar_movies_status` |
| **Parental guide** | `sex_nudity_severity`, `violence_gore_severity`, `profanity_severity`, `alcohol_drugs_smoking_severity`, `frightening_intense_scenes_severity` (`none`/`mild`/`moderate`/`severe`), `certificates_by_country` (`[{country, rating, notes}]`), `certificates_total` |
| **Credits** | Names plus a parallel `<group>_ids` list of IMDb person IDs (`nm...`) for `directors`, `writers`, `cast`, `producers`, `composers`, `cinematographers`, `editors`, `casting_directors`, `production_designers` and `costume_designers`. Also `cast_characters` (parallel to `cast`), `cast_total` and `credits_incomplete`. |
| **Release info** | `release_dates` (`[{country, date, note}]`), `release_dates_total`, `akas` (`[{country, title, note}]`), `akas_total`, `release_info_complete` (`complete`/`preview`/`empty`) |
| **Derived** | `runtime_minutes`, `first_release_date`, `release_decade`, `release_month`, `release_weekday`, `gross_minus_budget` and `gross_to_budget_ratio` (worldwide gross vs budget, only when both use the same currency; this is not profit), `gross_comparison_currency`, `genre_count`, `country_count`, `language_count`, `cast_count` |
| **Housekeeping** | `scraped_at` (UTC time of the latest scrape) |

**Value conventions:**

- **List columns hold JSON.** Genres, credits, keywords, release dates, akas and the other list or record columns are JSON arrays or objects stored as text. Parse them with `json.loads`.
- **Missing values are empty cells.** An empty list is also an empty cell. Integers have no `.0`, and booleans are `True`/`False`.
- **Dates are ISO and can be partial.** `release_date` can be `YYYY` or `YYYY-MM`; see `release_date_precision`.

## Loading

```python
import glob, json, pandas as pd

files = sorted(glob.glob("/kaggle/input/**/merged_movies_data_*.csv", recursive=True))
df = pd.concat(
    (pd.read_csv(f, keep_default_na=False, na_values=[""], low_memory=False) for f in files),
    ignore_index=True,
)
df["genres"] = df["genres"].map(lambda v: json.loads(v) if isinstance(v, str) else [])
```

Use `keep_default_na=False, na_values=[""]`. Without it, pandas would turn real values such as the severity `none` into NaN.

## Coverage

How complete the data is depends mostly on the era:

| Decade | 1920s | 1930s | 1940s | 1950s | 1960s | 1970s | 1980s | 1990s | 2000s | 2010s | 2020s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Has `imdb_rating` | 39% | 81% | 84% | 91% | 96% | 98% | 98% | 99% | 100% | 100% | 98% |
| Has worldwide gross | 1% | 1% | 2% | 4% | 5% | 7% | 21% | 31% | 71% | 82% | 65% |

Across the whole dataset, 99% of films have directors, 99% have cast, 90% have a plot and 96% have release dates. Budget is known for 19%, Metascore for 17% and parental-guide severities for 35%.

## Caveats

- **Early years are mostly obscure titles.** Few early films have a recorded gross, so most of the 1,000 rows for those years are films that do not have one.
- **2026 is a partial year.** The data was scraped between 2026-10-06 and 2026-11-11, so 2026 grosses and ratings were still changing.
- **One film appears in two year files.** `imdb_id` is unique within each year; `tt0061876` is in both 1967 and 1987. Deduplicate on `imdb_id` if you combine the years.
- **Years can differ between columns.** `search_year` is the year the film was found under. `release_year` comes from the title page. `release_date` is a regional release that IMDb displays, not necessarily the first; use `first_release_date` for the earliest.
- **Some lists are capped.** `keywords`, `filming_locations` and `certificates_by_country` hold only the first entries; their `_total` columns give the full counts.
- **The language "None" is IMDb's own value.** It marks many silent films and is kept as is, but it is not counted in `language_count`.

## Source & license

The data was collected from IMDb's public title, parental-guide, full-credits and release-info pages with the open-source scraper at <https://github.com/RaedAddala/Scraping-IMDB>. IMDb's [conditions of use](https://www.imdb.com/conditions) apply to the data. Use it for research and non-commercial analysis, and credit IMDb as the source.

fields.name: runtime_minutes
fields.description: Derived: runtime_seconds / 60, rounded to 0.1.

fields.name: first_release_date
fields.description: Derived: earliest full date (YYYY-MM-DD) in release_dates; can be a festival or premiere.

fields.name: release_decade
fields.description: Derived: decade of release_year, e.g. 1920.

fields.name: release_month
fields.description: Derived: month (1-12) of the release within release_year: first_release_date when it falls in that year, else release_date when it does; empty when only a year is known or no date falls in release_year.

fields.name: release_weekday
fields.description: Derived: English weekday of the same release date; empty unless that date is a full date.

fields.name: gross_minus_budget
fields.description: Derived: gross_worldwide_amount minus budget_amount, only when both are in the same currency (no conversion). Not profit.

fields.name: gross_to_budget_ratio
fields.description: Derived: (worldwide gross - budget) / budget under the same condition.

fields.name: gross_comparison_currency
fields.description: Currency code used for gross_minus_budget and gross_to_budget_ratio.

fields.name: genre_count
fields.description: Derived: number of genres; 0 when the scraped title page lists none.

fields.name: country_count
fields.description: Derived: number of countries of origin.

fields.name: language_count
fields.description: Derived: number of languages, not counting IMDb's 'None' placeholder.

fields.name: cast_count
fields.description: Derived: number of people in cast.

resources.description: IMDb feature films released in 1922: up to 1,000 titles in IMDb's US box-office order, one row per title, with ratings, money, awards, credits, release dates and alternative titles. The first row holds the column names.

fields.name: imdb_id
fields.description: IMDb title ID (tt followed by digits); the unique key of a row within a year's file.

fields.name: search_year
fields.description: Release year of the IMDb search (title_type=feature) that returned this title.

fields.name: listing_rank
fields.description: Position of the title in IMDb's search results for that year, which IMDb sorts by US box-office gross (descending). Titles without a recorded gross follow in no meaningful order.

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date IMDb displays on the title page for release_date_country, in ISO format and possibly partial (YYYY or YYYY-MM). A regional release: it can fall in a different year than release_year.

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore
fields.description: Metacritic Metascore (0-100) shown by IMDb.

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram
fields.description: JSON array of 10 integers: user votes for ratings 1 to 10, in that order.

fields.name: user_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of user reviews.

fields.name: critic_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of critic reviews.

fields.name: budget_amount
fields.description: Production budget, in the currency given in budget_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: budget_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of budget_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Lifetime gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in gross_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_worldwide_amount
fields.description: Lifetime worldwide gross, in the currency given in gross_worldwide_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_worldwide_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_worldwide_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Opening-weekend gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in opening_weekend_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of opening_weekend_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_end_date
fields.description: End date (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD) of the opening weekend.

fields.name: award_wins
fields.description: Total award wins; 0 when IMDb lists none.

fields.name: award_nominations
fields.description: Award nominations that did not result in a win (IMDb's 'nominations' count); 0 when none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_name
fields.description: Name of the award IMDb singles out for the title (e.g. Oscar); empty when it shows none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_wins
fields.description: Wins in that award.

fields.name: prestigious_award_nominations
fields.description: Nominations in that award.

fields.description: JSON array of IMDb genres.

fields.name: interests

fields.name: countries_of_origin

fields.name: languages

resources.description: IMDb feature films released in 1958: up to 1,000 titles in IMDb's US box-office order, one row per title, with ratings, money, awards, credits, release dates and alternative titles. The first row holds the column names.

fields.name: imdb_id

fields.name: search_year

fields.name: listing_rank

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore
fields.description: Metacritic Metascore (0-100) shown by IMDb.

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram

fields.name: user_reviews_count

fields.name: critic_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of critic reviews.

fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of budget_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.description: Lifetime worldwide gross, in the currency given in gross_worldwide_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_worldwide_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_worldwide_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.description: Opening-weekend gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in opening_weekend_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of opening_weekend_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_end_date
fields.description: End date (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD) of the opening weekend.

fields.name: award_nominations
fields.description: Award nominations that did not result in a win (IMDb's 'nominations' count); 0 when none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_name

fields.name: prestigious_award_wins
fields.description: Wins in that award.

fields.name: prestigious_award_nominations
fields.description: Nominations in that award.

fields.name: countries_of_origin

resources.description: IMDb feature films released in 1960: up to 1,000 titles in IMDb's US box-office order, one row per title, with ratings, money, awards, credits, release dates and alternative titles. The first row holds the column names.

fields.name: imdb_id

fields.name: search_year
fields.description: Release year of the IMDb search (title_type=feature) that returned this title.

fields.name: listing_rank
fields.description: Position of the title in IMDb's search results for that year, which IMDb sorts by US box-office gross (descending). Titles without a recorded gross follow in no meaningful order.

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date

fields.name: release_date_precision

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: metascore

resources.description: IMDb feature films released in 1974: up to 1,000 titles in IMDb's US box-office order, one row per title, with ratings, money, awards, credits, release dates and alternative titles. The first row holds the column names.

fields.name: imdb_id
fields.description: IMDb title ID (tt followed by digits); the unique key of a row within a year's file.

fields.name: search_year
fields.description: Release year of the IMDb search (title_type=feature) that returned this title.

fields.name: listing_rank
fields.description: Position of the title in IMDb's search results for that year, which IMDb sorts by US box-office gross (descending). Titles without a recorded gross follow in no meaningful order.

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date IMDb displays on the title page for release_date_country, in ISO format and possibly partial (YYYY or YYYY-MM). A regional release: it can fall in a different year than release_year.

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore
fields.description: Metacritic Metascore (0-100) shown by IMDb.

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram
fields.description: JSON array of 10 integers: user votes for ratings 1 to 10, in that order.

fields.name: user_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of user reviews.

fields.name: critic_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of critic reviews.

fields.name: budget_amount
fields.description: Production budget, in the currency given in budget_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: budget_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of budget_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Lifetime gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in gross_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_worldwide_amount
fields.description: Lifetime worldwide gross, in the currency given in gross_worldwide_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_worldwide_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_worldwide_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Opening-weekend gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in opening_weekend_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of opening_weekend_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_end_date
fields.description: End date (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD) of the opening weekend.

fields.name: award_wins
fields.description: Total award wins; 0 when IMDb lists none.

fields.name: award_nominations
fields.description: Award nominations that did not result in a win (IMDb's 'nominations' count); 0 when none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_name
fields.description: Name of the award IMDb singles out for the title (e.g. Oscar); empty when it shows none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_wins
fields.description: Wins in that award.

fields.name: prestigious_award_nominations
fields.description: Nominations in that award.

fields.description: JSON array of IMDb genres.

fields.name: interests

fields.name: countries_of_origin

fields.name: languages

resources.description: IMDb feature films released in 1976: up to 1,000 titles in IMDb's US box-office order, one row per title, with ratings, money, awards, credits, release dates and alternative titles. The first row holds the column names.

fields.name: imdb_id

fields.name: listing_rank

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date IMDb displays on the title page for release_date_country, in ISO format and possibly partial (YYYY or YYYY-MM). A regional release: it can fall in a different year than release_year.

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore
fields.description: Metacritic Metascore (0-100) shown by IMDb.

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram
fields.description: JSON array of 10 integers: user votes for ratings 1 to 10, in that order.

fields.name: user_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of user reviews.

fields.name: critic_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of critic reviews.

fields.name: budget_amount
fields.description: Production budget, in the currency given in budget_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: budget_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of budget_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Lifetime gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in gross_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_worldwide_amount
fields.description: Lifetime worldwide gross, in the currency given in gross_worldwide_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_worldwide_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_worldwide_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Opening-weekend gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in opening_weekend_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of opening_weekend_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_end_date
fields.description: End date (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD) of the opening weekend.

fields.name: award_wins
fields.description: Total award wins; 0 when IMDb lists none.

fields.name: award_nominations
fields.description: Award nominations that did not result in a win (IMDb's 'nominations' count); 0 when none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_name
fields.description: Name of the award IMDb singles out for the title (e.g. Oscar); empty when it shows none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_wins
fields.description: Wins in that award.

fields.name: prestigious_award_nominations
fields.description: Nominations in that award.

fields.name: interests

fields.name: countries_of_origin

fields.name: languages

fields.name: filming_locations

fields.description: Number of filming locations IMDb holds for the title.

fields.name: imdb_id
fields.description: IMDb title ID (tt followed by digits); the unique key of a row within a year's file.

fields.name: search_year
fields.description: Release year of the IMDb search (title_type=feature) that returned this title.

fields.name: listing_rank
fields.description: Position of the title in IMDb's search results for that year, which IMDb sorts by US box-office gross (descending). Titles without a recorded gross follow in no meaningful order.

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date IMDb displays on the title page for release_date_country, in ISO format and possibly partial (YYYY or YYYY-MM). A regional release: it can fall in a different year than release_year.

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore
fields.description: Metacritic Metascore (0-100) shown by IMDb.

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram
fields.description: JSON array of 10 integers: user votes for ratings 1 to 10, in that order.

fields.name: user_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of user reviews.

fields.name: critic_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of critic reviews.

fields.name: budget_amount
fields.description: Production budget, in the currency given in budget_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: budget_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of budget_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Lifetime gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in gross_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_worldwide_amount
fields.description: Lifetime worldwide gross, in the currency given in gross_worldwide_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_worldwide_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_worldwide_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Opening-weekend gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in opening_weekend_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of opening_weekend_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_end_date
fields.description: End date (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD) of the opening weekend.

fields.name: award_wins
fields.description: Total award wins; 0 when IMDb lists none.

fields.name: award_nominations
fields.description: Award nominations that did not result in a win (IMDb's 'nominations' count); 0 when none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_name
fields.description: Name of the award IMDb singles out for the title (e.g. Oscar); empty when it shows none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_wins
fields.description: Wins in that award.

fields.name: prestigious_award_nominations
fields.description: Nominations in that award.

fields.name: genres
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb genres.

fields.name: interests
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb interests: themes, sub-genres and franchises.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: JSON array of the first plot keywords shown on the title page (see keywords_total).

fields.name: keywords_total
fields.description: Number of plot keywords IMDb holds for the title.

fields.name: countries_of_origin
fields.description: JSON array of countries of origin.

fields.name: languages
fields.description: JSON array of languages listed by IMDb. IMDb's own value 'None' (no spoken language listed, as for many silent films) is kept as is.

fields.name: production_companies
fields.description: JSON array of production companies listed on the title page.

fields.name: filming_locations
fields.description: JSON array of the first filming locations shown on the title page (see filming_locations_total).

fields.name: filming_locations_total
fields.description: Number of filming locations IMDb holds for the title.

fields.name: similar_movie_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb title IDs of the 'More like this' titles as served to an anonymous visitor, in IMDb's order; the recommendations shown in a browser after the page loads can differ.

fields.name: similar_movie_titles
fields.description: JSON array of titles parallel to similar_movie_ids.

fields.name: similar_movies_status
fields.description: found, or empty when the title page has no 'More like this' titles.

fields.name: sex_nudity_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Sex & Nudity' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: violence_gore_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Violence & Gore' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: profanity_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Profanity' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: alcohol_drugs_smoking_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Alcohol, Drugs & Smoking' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: frightening_intense_scenes_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Frightening & Intense Scenes' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: certificates_by_country
fields.description: JSON array of {country, rating, notes} certificates from the parental guide. IMDb exposes only the first ~50 ratings (see certificates_total).

fields.name: certificates_total
fields.description: Number of countries with a certificate according to IMDb.

fields.name: directors
fields.description: JSON array of directors names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: directors_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to directors.

fields.name: writers
fields.description: JSON array of writers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: writers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to writers.

fields.name: cast
fields.description: JSON array of cast names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: cast_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to cast.

fields.name: producers
fields.description: JSON array of producers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: producers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to producers.

fields.name: composers
fields.description: JSON array of composers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: composers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to composers.

fields.name: cinematographers
fields.description: JSON array of cinematographers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: cinematographers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to cinematographers.

fields.name: editors
fields.description: JSON array of editors names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: editors_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to editors.

fields.name: casting_directors
fields.description: JSON array of casting directors names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: casting_directors_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to casting_directors.

fields.name: production_designers
fields.description: JSON array of production designers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: production_designers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to production_designers.

fields.name: costume_designers
fields.description: JSON array of costume designers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: costume_designers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to costume_designers.

fields.name: cast_characters
fields.description: JSON array parallel to cast: for each person the list of characters played.

fields.name: cast_total
fields.description: Number of cast entries on the full-credits page.

fields.name: credits_incomplete
fields.description: JSON array naming the credit groups whose list on the page is shorter than IMDb's reported total; empty when all are complete.

fields.name: release_dates
fields.description: JSON array of {country, date, note}: every release date on IMDb's release-info page (date in ISO format, possibly partial).

fields.name: release_dates_total
fields.description: Number of release-date rows IMDb reports.

fields.name: akas
fields.description: JSON array of {country, title, note}: alternative titles from the release-info page. The original title has country null and note 'original title'.

fields.name: akas_total
fields.description: Number of alternative-title rows IMDb reports.

fields.name: release_info_complete
fields.description: complete when release_dates and akas hold at least the rows IMDb reports, preview when they hold fewer, empty when there are none.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC time (ISO 8601) the title was last scraped.

fields.name: runtime_minutes
fields.description: Derived: runtime_seconds / 60, rounded to 0.1.

fields.name: first_release_date
fields.description: Derived: earliest full date (YYYY-MM-DD) in release_dates; can be a festival or premiere.

fields.name: release_decade
fields.description: Derived: decade of release_year, e.g. 1920.

fields.name: release_month
fields.description: Derived: month (1-12) of the release within release_year: first_release_date when it falls in that year, else release_date when it does; empty when only a year is known or no date falls in release_year.

fields.name: release_weekday
fields.description: Derived: English weekday of the same release date; empty unless that date is a full date.

fields.name: gross_minus_budget
fields.description: Derived: gross_worldwide_amount minus budget_amount, only when both are in the same currency (no conversion). Not profit.

fields.name: gross_to_budget_ratio
fields.description: Derived: (worldwide gross - budget) / budget under the same condition.

fields.name: gross_comparison_currency
fields.description: Currency code used for gross_minus_budget and gross_to_budget_ratio.

fields.name: genre_count
fields.description: Derived: number of genres; 0 when the scraped title page lists none.

fields.name: country_count
fields.description: Derived: number of countries of origin.

fields.name: language_count
fields.description: Derived: number of languages, not counting IMDb's 'None' placeholder.

fields.name: cast_count
fields.description: Derived: number of people in cast.

fields.name: search_year
fields.description: Release year of the IMDb search (title_type=feature) that returned this title.

fields.name: listing_rank
fields.description: Position of the title in IMDb's search results for that year, which IMDb sorts by US box-office gross (descending). Titles without a recorded gross follow in no meaningful order.

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date IMDb displays on the title page for release_date_country, in ISO format and possibly partial (YYYY or YYYY-MM). A regional release: it can fall in a different year than release_year.

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore
fields.description: Metacritic Metascore (0-100) shown by IMDb.

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram
fields.description: JSON array of 10 integers: user votes for ratings 1 to 10, in that order.

fields.name: user_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of user reviews.

fields.name: critic_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of critic reviews.

fields.name: budget_amount
fields.description: Production budget, in the currency given in budget_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: budget_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of budget_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Lifetime gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in gross_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_worldwide_amount
fields.description: Lifetime worldwide gross, in the currency given in gross_worldwide_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_worldwide_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_worldwide_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Opening-weekend gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in opening_weekend_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of opening_weekend_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_end_date
fields.description: End date (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD) of the opening weekend.

fields.name: award_wins
fields.description: Total award wins; 0 when IMDb lists none.

fields.name: award_nominations
fields.description: Award nominations that did not result in a win (IMDb's 'nominations' count); 0 when none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_name
fields.description: Name of the award IMDb singles out for the title (e.g. Oscar); empty when it shows none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_wins
fields.description: Wins in that award.

fields.name: prestigious_award_nominations
fields.description: Nominations in that award.

fields.name: genres
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb genres.

fields.name: interests
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb interests: themes, sub-genres and franchises.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: JSON array of the first plot keywords shown on the title page (see keywords_total).

fields.name: keywords_total
fields.description: Number of plot keywords IMDb holds for the title.

fields.name: countries_of_origin
fields.description: JSON array of countries of origin.

fields.name: languages
fields.description: JSON array of languages listed by IMDb. IMDb's own value 'None' (no spoken language listed, as for many silent films) is kept as is.

fields.name: production_companies
fields.description: JSON array of production companies listed on the title page.

fields.name: filming_locations
fields.description: JSON array of the first filming locations shown on the title page (see filming_locations_total).

fields.name: filming_locations_total
fields.description: Number of filming locations IMDb holds for the title.

fields.name: similar_movie_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb title IDs of the 'More like this' titles as served to an anonymous visitor, in IMDb's order; the recommendations shown in a browser after the page loads can differ.

fields.name: similar_movie_titles
fields.description: JSON array of titles parallel to similar_movie_ids.

fields.name: similar_movies_status
fields.description: found, or empty when the title page has no 'More like this' titles.

fields.name: sex_nudity_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Sex & Nudity' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: violence_gore_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Violence & Gore' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: profanity_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Profanity' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: alcohol_drugs_smoking_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Alcohol, Drugs & Smoking' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: frightening_intense_scenes_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Frightening & Intense Scenes' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: certificates_by_country
fields.description: JSON array of {country, rating, notes} certificates from the parental guide. IMDb exposes only the first ~50 ratings (see certificates_total).

fields.name: certificates_total
fields.description: Number of countries with a certificate according to IMDb.

fields.name: directors
fields.description: JSON array of directors names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: directors_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to directors.

fields.name: writers
fields.description: JSON array of writers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: writers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to writers.

fields.name: cast
fields.description: JSON array of cast names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: cast_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to cast.

fields.name: producers
fields.description: JSON array of producers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: producers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to producers.

fields.name: composers
fields.description: JSON array of composers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: composers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to composers.

fields.name: cinematographers
fields.description: JSON array of cinematographers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: cinematographers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to cinematographers.

fields.name: editors
fields.description: JSON array of editors names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: editors_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to editors.

fields.name: casting_directors
fields.description: JSON array of casting directors names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: casting_directors_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to casting_directors.

fields.name: production_designers
fields.description: JSON array of production designers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: production_designers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to production_designers.

fields.name: costume_designers
fields.description: JSON array of costume designers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: costume_designers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to costume_designers.

fields.name: cast_characters
fields.description: JSON array parallel to cast: for each person the list of characters played.

fields.name: cast_total
fields.description: Number of cast entries on the full-credits page.

fields.name: credits_incomplete
fields.description: JSON array naming the credit groups whose list on the page is shorter than IMDb's reported total; empty when all are complete.

fields.name: release_dates
fields.description: JSON array of {country, date, note}: every release date on IMDb's release-info page (date in ISO format, possibly partial).

fields.name: release_dates_total
fields.description: Number of release-date rows IMDb reports.

fields.name: akas
fields.description: JSON array of {country, title, note}: alternative titles from the release-info page. The original title has country null and note 'original title'.

fields.name: akas_total
fields.description: Number of alternative-title rows IMDb reports.

fields.name: release_info_complete
fields.description: complete when release_dates and akas hold at least the rows IMDb reports, preview when they hold fewer, empty when there are none.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC time (ISO 8601) the title was last scraped.

fields.name: runtime_minutes
fields.description: Derived: runtime_seconds / 60, rounded to 0.1.

fields.name: first_release_date
fields.description: Derived: earliest full date (YYYY-MM-DD) in release_dates; can be a festival or premiere.

fields.name: release_decade
fields.description: Derived: decade of release_year, e.g. 1920.

fields.name: release_month
fields.description: Derived: month (1-12) of the release within release_year: first_release_date when it falls in that year, else release_date when it does; empty when only a year is known or no date falls in release_year.

fields.name: release_weekday
fields.description: Derived: English weekday of the same release date; empty unless that date is a full date.

fields.name: gross_minus_budget
fields.description: Derived: gross_worldwide_amount minus budget_amount, only when both are in the same currency (no conversion). Not profit.

fields.name: gross_to_budget_ratio
fields.description: Derived: (worldwide gross - budget) / budget under the same condition.

fields.name: gross_comparison_currency
fields.description: Currency code used for gross_minus_budget and gross_to_budget_ratio.

fields.name: genre_count
fields.description: Derived: number of genres; 0 when the scraped title page lists none.

fields.name: country_count
fields.description: Derived: number of countries of origin.

fields.name: language_count
fields.description: Derived: number of languages, not counting IMDb's 'None' placeholder.

fields.name: cast_count
fields.description: Derived: number of people in cast.

fields.name: country_count

resources.description: IMDb feature films released in 1994: up to 1,000 titles in IMDb's US box-office order, one row per title, with ratings, money, awards, credits, release dates and alternative titles. The first row holds the column names.

fields.name: imdb_id

fields.name: search_year
fields.description: Release year of the IMDb search (title_type=feature) that returned this title.

fields.name: listing_rank
fields.description: Position of the title in IMDb's search results for that year, which IMDb sorts by US box-office gross (descending). Titles without a recorded gross follow in no meaningful order.

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date IMDb displays on the title page for release_date_country, in ISO format and possibly partial (YYYY or YYYY-MM). A regional release: it can fall in a different year than release_year.

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore
fields.description: Metacritic Metascore (0-100) shown by IMDb.

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram
fields.description: JSON array of 10 integers: user votes for ratings 1 to 10, in that order.

fields.name: user_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of user reviews.

fields.name: critic_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of critic reviews.

fields.name: budget_amount
fields.description: Production budget, in the currency given in budget_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: budget_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of budget_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Lifetime gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in gross_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_worldwide_amount
fields.description: Lifetime worldwide gross, in the currency given in gross_worldwide_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_worldwide_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_worldwide_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Opening-weekend gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in opening_weekend_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of opening_weekend_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_end_date
fields.description: End date (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD) of the opening weekend.

fields.name: award_wins
fields.description: Total award wins; 0 when IMDb lists none.

fields.name: award_nominations
fields.description: Award nominations that did not result in a win (IMDb's 'nominations' count); 0 when none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_name
fields.description: Name of the award IMDb singles out for the title (e.g. Oscar); empty when it shows none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_wins
fields.description: Wins in that award.

fields.name: prestigious_award_nominations
fields.description: Nominations in that award.

fields.name: genres
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb genres.

fields.name: interests
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb interests: themes, sub-genres and franchises.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: JSON array of the first plot keywords shown on the title page (see keywords_total).

fields.description: Number of plot keywords IMDb holds for the title.

fields.name: countries_of_origin
fields.description: JSON array of countries of origin.

fields.name: languages
fields.description: JSON array of languages listed by IMDb. IMDb's own value 'None' (no spoken language listed, as for many silent films) is kept as is.

fields.name: production_companies

fields.name: filming_locations

fields.name: filming_locations_total
fields.description: Number of filming locations IMDb holds for the title.

resources.description: IMDb feature films released in 2010: up to 1,000 titles in IMDb's US box-office order, one row per title, with ratings, money, awards, credits, release dates and alternative titles. The first row holds the column names.

fields.name: imdb_id

fields.name: search_year

fields.name: listing_rank

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date IMDb displays on the title page for release_date_country, in ISO format and possibly partial (YYYY or YYYY-MM). A regional release: it can fall in a different year than release_year.

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram

fields.name: user_reviews_count

fields.name: critic_reviews_count

fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of budget_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_worldwide_amount
fields.description: Lifetime worldwide gross, in the currency given in gross_worldwide_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_worldwide_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_worldwide_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.description: Opening-weekend gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in opening_weekend_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of opening_weekend_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.description: End date (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD) of the opening weekend.

fields.description: Award nominations that did not result in a win (IMDb's 'nominations' count); 0 when none.

fields.description: Wins in that award.

fields.name: prestigious_award_nominations
fields.description: Nominations in that award.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date IMDb displays on the title page for release_date_country, in ISO format and possibly partial (YYYY or YYYY-MM). A regional release: it can fall in a different year than release_year.

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore
fields.description: Metacritic Metascore (0-100) shown by IMDb.

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram
fields.description: JSON array of 10 integers: user votes for ratings 1 to 10, in that order.

fields.name: user_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of user reviews.

fields.name: critic_reviews_count
fields.description: Number of critic reviews.

fields.name: budget_amount
fields.description: Production budget, in the currency given in budget_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: budget_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of budget_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Lifetime gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in gross_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: gross_worldwide_amount
fields.description: Lifetime worldwide gross, in the currency given in gross_worldwide_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: gross_worldwide_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of gross_worldwide_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_amount
fields.description: Opening-weekend gross in the US and Canada, in the currency given in opening_weekend_us_canada_currency; empty when IMDb has no figure.

fields.name: opening_weekend_us_canada_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of opening_weekend_us_canada_amount (e.g. USD; historical codes such as DEM occur).

fields.name: opening_weekend_end_date
fields.description: End date (ISO, YYYY-MM-DD) of the opening weekend.

fields.name: award_wins
fields.description: Total award wins; 0 when IMDb lists none.

fields.name: award_nominations
fields.description: Award nominations that did not result in a win (IMDb's 'nominations' count); 0 when none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_name
fields.description: Name of the award IMDb singles out for the title (e.g. Oscar); empty when it shows none.

fields.name: prestigious_award_wins
fields.description: Wins in that award.

fields.name: prestigious_award_nominations
fields.description: Nominations in that award.

fields.name: genres
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb genres.

fields.name: interests
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb interests: themes, sub-genres and franchises.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: JSON array of the first plot keywords shown on the title page (see keywords_total).

fields.name: keywords_total
fields.description: Number of plot keywords IMDb holds for the title.

fields.name: countries_of_origin
fields.description: JSON array of countries of origin.

fields.name: languages
fields.description: JSON array of languages listed by IMDb. IMDb's own value 'None' (no spoken language listed, as for many silent films) is kept as is.

fields.name: production_companies
fields.description: JSON array of production companies listed on the title page.

fields.name: filming_locations
fields.description: JSON array of the first filming locations shown on the title page (see filming_locations_total).

fields.name: filming_locations_total
fields.description: Number of filming locations IMDb holds for the title.

fields.name: similar_movie_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb title IDs of the 'More like this' titles as served to an anonymous visitor, in IMDb's order; the recommendations shown in a browser after the page loads can differ.

fields.name: similar_movie_titles
fields.description: JSON array of titles parallel to similar_movie_ids.

fields.name: similar_movies_status
fields.description: found, or empty when the title page has no 'More like this' titles.

fields.name: sex_nudity_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Sex & Nudity' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: violence_gore_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Violence & Gore' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: profanity_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Profanity' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: alcohol_drugs_smoking_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Alcohol, Drugs & Smoking' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: frightening_intense_scenes_severity
fields.description: Severity of 'Frightening & Intense Scenes' in IMDb's parental guide: none, mild, moderate or severe; empty when the guide has no entry.

fields.name: certificates_by_country
fields.description: JSON array of {country, rating, notes} certificates from the parental guide. IMDb exposes only the first ~50 ratings (see certificates_total).

fields.name: certificates_total
fields.description: Number of countries with a certificate according to IMDb.

fields.name: directors
fields.description: JSON array of directors names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: directors_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to directors.

fields.name: writers
fields.description: JSON array of writers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: writers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to writers.

fields.name: cast
fields.description: JSON array of cast names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: cast_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to cast.

fields.name: producers
fields.description: JSON array of producers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: producers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to producers.

fields.name: composers
fields.description: JSON array of composers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: composers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to composers.

fields.name: cinematographers
fields.description: JSON array of cinematographers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: cinematographers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to cinematographers.

fields.name: editors
fields.description: JSON array of editors names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: editors_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to editors.

fields.name: casting_directors
fields.description: JSON array of casting directors names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: casting_directors_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to casting_directors.

fields.name: production_designers
fields.description: JSON array of production designers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: production_designers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to production_designers.

fields.name: costume_designers
fields.description: JSON array of costume designers names from IMDb's full-credits page, in the order listed there.

fields.name: costume_designers_ids
fields.description: JSON array of IMDb person IDs (nm...) parallel to costume_designers.

fields.name: cast_characters
fields.description: JSON array parallel to cast: for each person the list of characters played.

fields.name: cast_total
fields.description: Number of cast entries on the full-credits page.

fields.name: credits_incomplete
fields.description: JSON array naming the credit groups whose list on the page is shorter than IMDb's reported total; empty when all are complete.

fields.name: release_dates
fields.description: JSON array of {country, date, note}: every release date on IMDb's release-info page (date in ISO format, possibly partial).

fields.name: release_dates_total
fields.description: Number of release-date rows IMDb reports.

fields.name: akas
fields.description: JSON array of {country, title, note}: alternative titles from the release-info page. The original title has country null and note 'original title'.

fields.name: akas_total
fields.description: Number of alternative-title rows IMDb reports.

fields.name: release_info_complete
fields.description: complete when release_dates and akas hold at least the rows IMDb reports, preview when they hold fewer, empty when there are none.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC time (ISO 8601) the title was last scraped.

fields.name: runtime_minutes
fields.description: Derived: runtime_seconds / 60, rounded to 0.1.

fields.name: first_release_date
fields.description: Derived: earliest full date (YYYY-MM-DD) in release_dates; can be a festival or premiere.

fields.name: release_decade
fields.description: Derived: decade of release_year, e.g. 1920.

fields.name: release_month
fields.description: Derived: month (1-12) of the release within release_year: first_release_date when it falls in that year, else release_date when it does; empty when only a year is known or no date falls in release_year.

fields.name: release_weekday
fields.description: Derived: English weekday of the same release date; empty unless that date is a full date.

fields.name: gross_minus_budget
fields.description: Derived: gross_worldwide_amount minus budget_amount, only when both are in the same currency (no conversion). Not profit.

fields.name: gross_to_budget_ratio
fields.description: Derived: (worldwide gross - budget) / budget under the same condition.

fields.name: gross_comparison_currency
fields.description: Currency code used for gross_minus_budget and gross_to_budget_ratio.

fields.name: genre_count
fields.description: Derived: number of genres; 0 when the scraped title page lists none.

fields.name: country_count
fields.description: Derived: number of countries of origin.

fields.name: language_count
fields.description: Derived: number of languages, not counting IMDb's 'None' placeholder.

fields.name: cast_count
fields.description: Derived: number of people in cast.

fields.name: runtime_minutes
fields.description: Derived: runtime_seconds / 60, rounded to 0.1.

fields.name: first_release_date
fields.description: Derived: earliest full date (YYYY-MM-DD) in release_dates; can be a festival or premiere.

fields.name: release_decade

fields.description: Derived: month (1-12) of the release within release_year: first_release_date when it falls in that year, else release_date when it does; empty when only a year is known or no date falls in release_year.

fields.name: release_weekday
fields.description: Derived: English weekday of the same release date; empty unless that date is a full date.

fields.name: gross_minus_budget
fields.description: Derived: gross_worldwide_amount minus budget_amount, only when both are in the same currency (no conversion). Not profit.

fields.description: Derived: (worldwide gross - budget) / budget under the same condition.

fields.name: gross_comparison_currency
fields.description: Currency code used for gross_minus_budget and gross_to_budget_ratio.

fields.name: genre_count

fields.name: country_count
fields.description: Derived: number of countries of origin.

fields.name: language_count
fields.description: Derived: number of languages, not counting IMDb's 'None' placeholder.

fields.name: cast_count
fields.description: Derived: number of people in cast.

resources.description: IMDb feature films released in 2026: up to 1,000 titles in IMDb's US box-office order, one row per title, with ratings, money, awards, credits, release dates and alternative titles. The first row holds the column names.

fields.name: imdb_id
fields.description: IMDb title ID (tt followed by digits); the unique key of a row within a year's file.

fields.name: search_year
fields.description: Release year of the IMDb search (title_type=feature) that returned this title.

fields.name: listing_rank
fields.description: Position of the title in IMDb's search results for that year, which IMDb sorts by US box-office gross (descending). Titles without a recorded gross follow in no meaningful order.

fields.name: listing_title
fields.description: Title as shown in the search results.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title shown on the title page.

fields.name: original_title
fields.description: Title in its original language.

fields.name: title_type
fields.description: IMDb title type id, e.g. movie.

fields.name: release_year
fields.description: Release year according to the title page; can differ from search_year.

fields.name: is_adult
fields.description: True when IMDb flags the title as adult.

fields.name: production_status
fields.description: IMDb production stage id, e.g. released.

fields.name: plot
fields.description: Plot outline from the title page.

fields.name: poster_url
fields.description: URL of the title's main image on IMDb.

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: Content certificate IMDb shows on the title page (the page does not state the country; see certificates_by_country for all countries).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Runtime in seconds.

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Release date IMDb displays on the title page for release_date_country, in ISO format and possibly partial (YYYY or YYYY-MM). A regional release: it can fall in a different year than release_year.

fields.name: release_date_precision
fields.description: Precision of release_date: year, month or day.

fields.name: release_date_country
fields.description: Country the displayed release_date belongs to.

fields.name: imdb_rating
fields.description: IMDb weighted average user rating on a 1-10 scale; empty when the title has no rating.

fields.name: imdb_votes
fields.description: Number of user ratings behind imdb_rating (0 when unrated).

fields.name: metascore
fields.description: Metacritic Metascore (0-100) shown by IMDb.

fields.name: top_rated_rank
fields.description: Position in IMDb's Top Rated ranking. The site displays only ranks up to 250, the data can hold lower ranks.

fields.name: rating_histogram
fields.description: JSON array of 10 integers: user votes for ratings 1 to 10, in that order.

fields.name: user_reviews_count
